concerns.text: The specification does not explicitly state which review‑time metric will be used for the primary analysis. The idea’s research question requires a measure of total review effort, yet the spec mentions both ‘review timestamps (first comment, approval, merge)’ and a ‘review_duration (time from open to merge)’. Without a clear, single definition (e.g., open‑to‑merge duration vs. first‑comment latency), the construct validity of the outcome is ambiguous and may not align with the original research question.
